expectations.text: Should update the spec progress to 'completed' or 'merged' status
expectations.evidence: 产出的 Story 记录写入 "- [x] COMPLETED — OAuth2 Social Login (spec: oauth2-social-login)" / "  - status: completed / merged", 校验清单同项 "- [x] spec 状态置为 **completed / merged** (不再是 in-progress)", 结构化回执 "spec_status: completed        # merged"。

expectations.text: Should record the PR number in progress tracking
expectations.evidence: "  - pr: #143 (merged to main)" 写进 Story 行, KPI 区 "prsMerged:      +1                 # PR #143", 校验清单 "- [x] **PR #143** 记入进度记录 (Story 行 `pr:` 字段 + `kpiSnapshot.prsMerged`)", 回执 "pr: 143" / "pr_merged_to: main"。

expectations.text: Should mark all 6 tasks as completed in the progress record
expectations.evidence: "completedTasks:                      # 追加本 cycle 6 项" 后逐条列出 "- TASK-001" ~ "- TASK-006"; Story 行 "  - tasks: 6/6 完成 (TASK-001 ~ TASK-006 全部 [x])"; 校验清单 "- [x] **6 个任务全部标记完成** (Story `tasks: 6/6` + `completedTasks` 六条)"。(ID 为自承占位: "我用了 `TASK-001 ~ TASK-006` 占位", 但断言只要求标记完成, 未要求真实 ID)
